📺 Reacher (2022–Present)

Reacher follows Jack Reacher, a former U.S. Army military police investigator who travels across America with little more than the clothes on his back, relying on his extraordinary intelligence, physical strength, and combat experience to survive dangerous situations. Preferring a quiet life without permanent attachments, Reacher moves from town to town, but his strong sense of justice repeatedly draws him into complicated criminal investigations and violent confrontations. When he arrives in the small Georgia town of Margrave, he unexpectedly becomes the prime suspect in a brutal murder investigation, forcing him to uncover a dangerous conspiracy involving corruption, organized crime, and powerful individuals determined to protect their secrets. As Reacher investigates, he forms unexpected alliances with local law enforcement officers while using his exceptional investigative abilities and military training to expose the truth. Throughout the series, his adventures lead him into increasingly dangerous situations involving mysterious deaths, criminal organizations, betrayal, and threats connected to his military past. Despite facing heavily armed enemies and powerful adversaries, Reacher remains fearless, calculating, and determined to protect innocent people. His unconventional methods, sharp observations, and relentless fighting skills make him a formidable opponent for anyone standing in his way. Beyond its intense action and gripping mysteries, the series explores loyalty, friendship, justice, personal freedom, and the lasting bonds formed through shared experiences. Starring Alan Ritchson, Reacher combines explosive action, suspenseful investigations, clever dialogue, and unforgettable confrontations into a thrilling crime drama.
